fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestPickNoLeaves|TestDaemonPicks' shows a leafless, milestone-serving change set dispatched to a workflow starting with an agent step that declares checks picked, the same change set dispatched to a workflow starting with a leaves step skipped as no-leaves, a leafless backlog change set still skipped, and an umbrella change set still not ready. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-needs-leaves shows rhiza run start --workflow ship-change still refusing a leafless change set with 'has no leaves' and next 'rhiza run start --workflow plan' when ship-change starts with a command or leaves step, and starting the run on the same leafless change set when the repo's ship-change starts with an agent step that declares checks (a fake agent, nothing reaching Claude Code, GitHub or Rex). Touches internal/api/daemon.go, internal/api/daemon_picks_test.go, internal/api/run.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/run-ship-needs-leaves.txtar.
fields.statement: The daemon picks an accepted, ready change set that serves a milestone and has no leaves when its dispatch resolves to the conductor default (a workflow whose first step is an agent step that declares checks), instead of skipping it; backlog change sets with no leaves and change sets dispatched to a classic workflow keep the no-leaves skip, and umbrella change sets stay not ready. rhiza run start lets such a leafless change set start: its no-leaves refusal (checkShipLeaves) applies to ship-change only when the workflow's first step is not an agent step that declares checks, so a ship-change overridden by the conductor default starts on a leafless change set and a classic ship-change still refuses one with the plan-first next command.
